title: How La Rocca says he composed Tiger Rag
summary: He explains Tiger Rag as built from a tango figure, London Bridge, a Sousa march and a German band, and disputes the quadrille origin.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
